name: FreeModel
description: 29 models behind one endpoint with a monthly 1M-token free allowance, no card.
overview: FreeModel serves 29 models — Claude, GPT, Gemini, Kimi, DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM, Grok and Seed among them — through an OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible endpoint at freemodel.in/v1. The free tier allows 1,000,000 tokens a month with no card, and every model is reachable on every plan, so the free allowance buys Claude Fable 5 tokens as readily as a small open model. Payments for paid tiers run through UPI in India or USDT, and the dashboard tracks spend per key and model.
free_access: No card; 29 models on every plan
UPI or USDT for paid tiers
notes: The same catalogue and dashboard also run on cleanapis.com, radoxai.com and oxionai.com; each needs its own signup and grants its own monthly allowance, so they are separate entries. codecraftapi.com runs it with no free tier.
